summary.text: Peter Bixby is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 13 who has served in the House since 2012, according to Ballotpedia, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bixby was born in Bar Harbor, Maine, and earned a B.A. from Yale University and an M.A. and Ph.D. from Indiana University at Bloomington.
His career experience includes working as a parent, a public and private school teacher, an editor for an internet company and a freelance writer.
Bixby won election to the House on November 6, 2012, and in 2018 and 2020 he was a candidate in Strafford 17, a three-seat district.
In 2022 he defeated Renee Blaisdell for the Strafford 13 seat, and in 2024 he defeated Daniel Furman.
He served on the Environment and Agriculture Committee in each session from 2013 through 2024, including as vice chair in 2019-2020.
Furman is again his Republican opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
